hmed-01-c2.text: National Library of Medicine, History of Medicine Division. Greek Medicine. U.S. National Library of Medicine.
hmed-01-c2.quote: The four bodily fluids, or humors, of blood, phlegm, yellow bile, and black bile
hmed-01-c2.claim: In Hippocratic medicine, your health was a balance between the four humours: blood, phlegm, yellow bile, and black bile.
